title: Effects lab · every fight effect on a click
description: The development effects lab (?fxlab, just dev-fx, src/fx-lab.ts): a panel over a real fight that plays each fight effect under a made-up attack name, element hits, fire, statuses and reactions on the picked fighter. Clicks its own buttons, as a person would. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: The lab over a fight: target and thrower, strength, ánima colour, and a button per attack, element, fire level, status and reaction
Cadena voltaica (arc) with an energy hit on the middle dog
Lluvia de meteoros (meteor) with a fire hit
Escudo (shield): an ally effect lands on the first ally even with a dog picked
Congelado III with the camera brought close to the dog
Parálisis: mojado is put on first, then the shock turns it
